testimonials.text: I found the course particularly interesting in how it explained the anaesthetic management of vaginal birth after caesarean (VBAC) in a clear and practical way. The discussion on the use of neuraxial analgesia (especially epidural) and its safety in VBAC patients was very insightful, as it challenged some common misconceptions and highlighted its benefits in labour management.
The risk factors and indications were the most interesting to me as they were wonderfully highlighted and explained.
Thank you for the well-structured course on anaesthetic considerations in TOLAC. The content was clinically relevant and will help in my daily practice. Looking forward to more such courses.
Most of it were interesting, especially the intrapartal recommendations and management parts.

The course very informative and useful for clinical practice. I appreciate the clear explanations and the focus on patient safety during VBAC. I look forward to more courses that include interactive case scenarios to enhance learning.
